Chapter 671: Sitting empty in the hall with academic spirit, discussing talents (Page 1)
Su Yuan turned it over and read it again. The scholarly spirit filled the hall and discussed the meritorious talents. Once upon a time they competed with each other (...), these old people should not come to me one by one to have a relationship with Taibaijinxing. If you don't support it, it's better to just stand up. Say one, two, three, four, five, and let the civil and military officials of the court listen to your opinions. Su Yuan was in a daze when he suddenly heard a loud voice and suppressed all the subtle whispers in the hall. The sky was covered with golden light, and layers of Qingyun surged from the sky. There are five colors, red or gold, purple or green, and there is faint fairy music floating in the Qingyun. There are goddesses scattering flowers, golden lamps floating and falling, and more than a dozen figures pouring in from the palace door as if they have made an appointment, including Wenqu Xingjun, Taibai Jinxing, and Zhen Yuanzi. When the heads of various ministries and deputy heaven-level officials, all of them twenty or thirty people, took their seats one by one, there were three cloud sounds on the stage, and three figures slowly emerged from the void, and the spiritual light slowly descended from the dome, and a large panorama appeared, showing the three emperors on the rostrum. Sitting side by side, the three colors of purple, gold and green are in harmony; under the rostrum, the immortals are present, densely packed with purple robes and gold belts. This picture is the official record of today's court meeting, which will be stored in the archives of the heaven and the Mingfa Three Realms. Emperor Ziwei raised his hand slightly, and Ge Hong stepped forward from the side and spoke loudly. He said: "The court meeting in the Tongming Palace, all the heavenly officials, ministers and representatives from the four continents should be present at 327 people, but the actual number is 315, which is the quorum. Let's start the meeting now." There was another shout, and the long study began. Yes, let’s learn from His Majesty’s new hair, and then learn from His Majesty’s new hair. Su Yuan originally thought that after five hundred years of training in Liangjie Mountain and traveling westward to learn scriptures, he had already developed an unshakable patience. But this court meeting was different from the past, and the shadow stone hung above his head. More than three hundred pairs of eyes are staring at each other, and no one dares to slack off. If you accidentally yawn, the news will spread throughout the Tongming Hall in less than half a day; if you accidentally fall asleep again, congratulations, the headlines in the entire Three Realms tomorrow will be "The new deputy minister of the Lei Department fell asleep at the meeting."
